The '''bio-fighter''' was a construct created by the same [[Charon/Legends|Charon]] [[Bioengineering/Legends|bioengineering]] that went into the ''[[Desolate]]''.

==Characteristics==
They were bulbous craft, armed with a single [[tri-laser pulse-cannon]] and weak [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]]. Two [[Charon/Legends|Charon]] crewed the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and a [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]]. Charon bio-fighters were not capable of entering [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].
